intro.title: A Mainland License — Your Strategic Advantage
intro.paragraph1: A Mainland License is one of the most flexible and powerful business licenses in the UAE — allowing entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses to conduct business in any of the seven Emirates without geographic restrictions.
intro.paragraph2: Unlike free zone licenses that limit activities to certain boundaries, a mainland license gives your business the right to deal with clients and work with government organizations anywhere in the country — allowing you to trade freely, without restrictions.
intro.paragraph3: A Mainland License lays a strong foundation for anyone wanting to base themselves in the UAE for the long term — whether you're opening a startup, scaling an SME, or expanding an international business. With relaxed foreign ownership rules, the UAE now allows 100% foreign ownership in most sectors.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Mainland License. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: What is a Mainland License in the UAE?
items.a: A Mainland License is a business license that permits a company to conduct business across all seven Emirates — including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah. Unlike a Free Zone license, it allows open trade with consumers, government entities, and businesses anywhere in the UAE without restriction.

items.q: Who can apply for a Mainland License?
items.a: Entrepreneurs, investors, SMEs, and international businesses can all apply. Recent UAE reforms allow 100% foreign ownership in most sectors, making it highly attractive for global businesses.

items.q: Is it possible for expats to have ownership over a Mainland company in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Under recent UAE business reforms, most mainland activities now allow 100% foreign ownership — no local partner required.

items.q: What are the advantages of having a Mainland License?
items.a: Key advantages include unlimited market access across all Emirates, government contract eligibility, employee and family sponsorship, credibility with banks, and long-term stability with renewal options.

items.q: Does the Mainland License require the need for a physical office?
items.a: Yes, most mainland licenses require a registered physical office or Ejari. We help you find the right office space matching your budget and requirements.

items.q: Is it possible to sponsor employees and family members under a Mainland License?
items.a: Yes. A Mainland License allows you to sponsor employees, family members, and domestic staff — with full compliance under UAE labor and immigration laws.

items.q: How long does it take to obtain a Mainland License?
items.a: Typically 2-4 weeks depending on the activity, documentation, and office space. We fast-track the process for our clients.

items.q: Can a Mainland company bid for government contracts?
items.a: Yes. Unlike Free Zone companies, Mainland businesses can bid directly for government tenders and public sector projects.

items.q: Does Setup Zone Dubai provide assistance with post-license services?
items.a: Yes. We offer ongoing post-license support — renewals, amendments, compliance, PRO services, and business growth advisory.

items.q: Why should I choose Setup Zone Dubai for my Mainland License?
items.a: We provide end-to-end support, strong UAE authority relationships for faster approvals, transparent pricing, and expert guidance at every step.
